comments.text:
This didn't happen in our game, but I think something like this should be included to prevent someone from making the CE/CN Murder Hobo. Having people pick starting locations helped prevent this so I don't think it will become a problem, but wordsmithing this can help players realize that they CAN make fun, creative, goofy, or evil characters, but that they still need to be a productive/collaborative citizen.
It's to avoid the THAT GUY stealing the loot/information while other peeps are fighting
